mapper.select: SELECT id, total_saved_carbon_kg AS totalSavedCarbonKg, total_saved_power_kwh AS totalSavedPowerKwh, total_saved_cost_krw AS totalSavedCostKrw, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM infra_esg_cumulative_metric LIMIT 1

SELECT id, log_date AS logDate, log_hour AS logHour, traditional_estimated_cpu_util AS traditionalEstimatedCpuUtil, optimized_actual_cpu_util AS optimizedActualCpuUtil, power_consumption_kw AS powerConsumptionKw, created_at AS createdAt FROM infra_power_hourly_log WHERE log_date = #{logDate} ORDER BY log_hour ASC
